sources.title: Ask HN: Best offline translation software (Linux)
sources.snippet:
Hi all, I'm looking for offline language translation software for linux. Languages I need are:
Spanish <-> English
Russian <-> English Chinese would also be nice. I'm a developer, so a pre-trained deep learning model would be acceptable and I'll just write a simple app around it, but anything would be good. Does anyone working in language processing tell me the current state of the art in open source? Must be offline! I dont want this text being sent to a server I dont control.

sources.title: Ideological Segregation Online and Offline *
sources.snippet: We use individual and aggregate data to ask how the Internet is changing the ideological segregation of the American electorate. Focusing on online news consumption, offline news consumption, and face-to-face social interactions, we define ideological segregation in each domain using standard indices from the literature on racial segregation. We find that ideological segregation of online news consumption is low in absolute terms, higher than the segregation of most offline news consumption, and significantly lower than the segregation of face-to-face interactions with neighbors, co-workers, or family members. We find no evidence that the Internet is becoming more segregated over time.

sources.title: Are Online and Offline Prices Similar? Evidence from Large Multi-Channel Retailers
sources.snippet: Online prices are increasingly used for measurement and research applications, yet little is known about their relation to prices collected offline, where most retail transactions take place. I conduct the first large-scale comparison of prices simultaneously collected from the websites and physical stores of 56 large multi-channel retailers in 10 countries. I find that price levels are identical about 72 percent of the time. Price changes are not synchronized but have similar frequencies and average sizes. These results have implications for national statistical offices, researchers using online data, and anyone interested in the effect of the Internet on retail prices. (JEL D22, L11, L81, O14)
